name: Upper Klamath Refuge
summary: Upper Klamath Refuge lookout: a 1935 Forest Service permit, a 1937 steel-tower move, a 1974 dismantling. Three foundation blocks remain (2015 visit); no public access.
design: Steel tower (1937 newspaper item); the 1935 permit covered a tower and cabin
status_note: Tower gone; three foundation blocks remain at the old refuge headquarters (2015 visit).

access.note: Signs at the compound entrances say No Public Access (2015 record). Wikipedia says the refuge is reached only by boat.

events.note: Forest Service special use permit (June 29, 1935) for a lookout tower and cabin supporting refuge administration; 30.05 acres of Forest Service land

Newspaper item (May 6, 1937): steel tower being dismantled at the Tule Lake biological survey headquarters for a move to the Upper Klamath Lake Preserve; completion of the move is not confirmed by the page
Dismantled by a crew from the Cave Junction Smoke Jumper base and transported to 'that site'; the entry does not name the destination
Site visit (May 2, 2015): three foundation blocks remain at the old refuge headquarters; No Public Access signs at compound entrances
